newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia average money rate up to 13.2 vs 11.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatia average money rate up to 13.2 vs 11.3 pct.

text.p: Croatia's average money market rate rose to 13.2 percent on Thursday from 11.3 percent after term loans topped cheaper call money in slower overall trade.
Interbank demand was considerably weaker partly because the central bank paid kuna to banks which had sold it foreign exchange two days ago, dealers said.
Settlements totalled only 14.6 million kuna, of which more than half were renewed term borrowings.
Interbank call money was steady at 10 percent though savings banks still paid a higher 10.5 percent.
One-week to two-month rates ranged betwen 10 and 18 percent for banks and one percentage point higher for savings banks.
The central bank's kuna midrates for Friday eased back to 6.1536 against the dollar and 3.5708 to the German mark. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
